entities.name: Pyridoxine 5'-phosphate synthase
observations: The 240-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to curated Coxiella burnetii PdxJ proteins.
The sequence contains a PdxJ domain (PF03740) spanning residues 4–236.
Curated homologs annotate the protein as cytosolic and homo-octameric, arranged as a tetramer of dimers.

entities.name: PdxJ ring-closure reaction
observations: 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate plus 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate yields pyridoxine 5'-phosphate, inorganic phosphate, 2 water, and a proton.
The reaction is assigned EC 2.6.99.2 and Rhea RHEA:15265.
This is a complicated ring-closure reaction in pyridoxine 5'-phosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: Pyridoxine biosynthesis
observations: PdxJ catalyzes the final step of pyridoxine 5'-phosphate biosynthesis from D-erythrose 4-phosphate.
